value: alpha^2+beta^2 = (a-2)^2 + 2(a+1) = a^2 - 2a + 6 = (a-1)^2 + 5, minimised at a = 1 (least value 5)
why: Vieta gives alpha+beta = a-2 and alpha*beta = -(a+1), so alpha^2+beta^2 = (a-2)^2 - 2(-(a+1)) = a^2-2a+6, a upward parabola with vertex at a=1; sympy confirms values 9, 6, 5, 6 at a = -1, 0, 1, 2, and the discriminant a^2+8 > 0 keeps the roots real for every a so no option is excluded on realness.

Cube-root-of-unity filter: 1+w+w^2 = 0 kills f(w) and f(w^2), leaving 3^n/3; brute-force expansion for n = 1..7 gives 1, 3, 9, 27, 81, 243, 729, matching 3^(n-1) exactly (option B, 3n, coincides only at the single point n=3 and fails everywhere else, so there is no ambiguity in the general formula).

Tabulating the difference for n = 4..11 gives 6, 10, 15, 21, 28, 36, 45, 55, so 10 occurs at n = 5 only and the other options (10, 8, 7) give 45, 28, 21.

The full odd-index sum for n = 15 is 2^14 = 16384; the series starts at k = 3, so it omits C(15,1) = 15, giving 16369. Exact integer summation confirms 16369, and the four options evaluate to 16384, 16369, 16399, 16383, so only B matches.

value: T2/T3 = 2a/((n-1)b) and T3/T4 of (a+b)^(n+3) = 3a/((n+1)b); equating gives 2(n+1) = 3(n-1), so n = 5
why: With T_(r+1) = C(n,r) a^(n-r) b^r, the two ratios reduce to 2a/((n-1)b) and 3a/((n+3-2)b) = 3a/((n+1)b), independent of a and b beyond the common factor a/b, so the equation is purely in n and gives n = 5. Sympy evaluated both ratios symbolically at n = 3, 4, 5, 6: only n = 5 makes them equal (both a/(2b)).

value: f(x) = cos x - 2x + (2 + cos x + 2 sin x - cos x log(1+x)) x^2 - 2x^3, whose Maclaurin coefficient of x is -2 (= f'(0))
why: Expanding along the third row gives f(x) = x^2[2(1+sin x) - cos x log(1+x)] - (1+x^2)(2x - cos x); every x^2-multiplied piece starts at x^2, so the only linear contribution is -2x from -(1)(2x) while cos x has no linear term. Sympy's series to x^3 is 1 - 2x + 5x^2/2 - x^3 and the direct derivative f'(0) = -2 agrees; -1, 0 and 1 are all excluded.
